# Evidence and open questions

## EVID-001 — Evidence title

**Status:** Verified
**As of:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Source:** [Primary source](https://example.com)
**Method:** Describe the query, experiment, or review.

**Finding:** State the sourced fact separately from any inference.

**Reverify when:** Give the expiry signal, such as implementation start,
dependency upgrade, deployment, or a fixed review date.

## OPEN-001 — Open question

**Status:** Open
**Owner:** Replace with owner
**Blocks:** `WP-001`, or `None`.

Describe the unresolved question and the evidence needed to close it.
